patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff did not apply to the Stage 01 checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:6181-fix image. On the original PoC that fixed build still reaches tail_escape_guard with next_char=0 but never emits tail_escape_decode. The adjacent `tail_escape_n_boundary` case changes only the final abstract byte from the terminal-backslash boundary to an escaped `n`, and both vulnerable and fixed binaries then execute tail_escape_decode and post_loop_increment cleanly with cursor_offset 1 -> 2.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before theme_format_expand_abstract() may treat the current backslash as an escape starter and enter the escape-decoding branch, the next byte p[1] must be non-NUL.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable guard checks only `*p == '\\'`. On the terminal-backslash case it still enters the escape-decoding branch even though no successor byte remains.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original trace records tail_escape_guard.next_char == 0 while tail_escape_decode still executes. The fixed original records the same next_char == 0 at tail_escape_guard but emits no tail_escape_decode, and the adjacent `tail_escape_n_boundary` case executes tail_escape_decode on both sides with next_char == 110.

nodes.description: At the next `while (*p != '\0')` loop test, the loop cursor already points past the heap string extent, so dereferencing `*p` performs the saved one-past-end read.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records oob_loop_test.cursor_offset=2 while oob_loop_test.ret_length=1.

edges.relation: After the terminal-backslash escape path has advanced `p` onto the terminator, the unconditional loop-end `p++` increases the same cursor from offset 1 to offset 2.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records tail_escape_decode.cursor_offset=1 and post_loop_increment.cursor_offset=2, and the adjacent `tail_escape_n_boundary` case records the same ordered increase with a non-terminal escape.

edges.relation: The one-past-end cursor produced by the loop-end increment is reused unchanged at the next `while (*p != '\0')` test.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records post_loop_increment.cursor_offset == oob_loop_test.cursor_offset == 2.
